278742117.description: This lot includes four vintage glass electrical insulators used for telegraph, telephone, and power lines. The insulators are made by Hemingray, an American manufacturer, with embossed markings such as 'Hemingray-42' and 'Hemingray-56'. Each insulator features a cylindrical shape with ridged sides and domed tops, measuring approximately 4 to 5 inches in height. The glass colors include clear and aqua/teal. The items are in good vintage condition with no major chips or cracks, showing minor wear consistent with age. Suitable for collectors or craft projects.

278306780.description: This large natural agate geode specimen features a polished face that reveals striking blue-gray and white banding with crystal formations at the center. The exterior retains its original rough texture with earthy brown, green, and tan tones. The piece weighs approximately 2.1 lbs and measures about 4 inches tall by 5.5 inches wide. There are price and inventory stickers from Goodwill on one side, and the specimen shows no visible major damage.

278928435.description: This collection includes a variety of rocks, minerals, fossils, and tumbled gemstones in multiple colors such as purple, yellow, white, green, blue, and brown. Among the specimens are rough minerals like quartz and possibly calcite geodes, along with fossilized coral and a fossil featuring a visible trilobite imprint. The assortment contains both natural and polished stones, including a labeled Labradorite specimen. All pieces are in good condition with no visible damage, and the lot features a range of sizes and shapes.

Description:
Elevate your space with this striking set of 2 Amethyst crystal bookends from The Ore Cart Rock Shop of Estes Park, Colorado. Each piece is crafted from genuine purple amethyst geode, presenting a vivid crystalline surface that naturally catches light and accentuates your decor. The bookends feature a raw, natural finish on the exterior, revealing the beauty of the mineral's sparkling interior. The underside is lined with protective black felt, as shown, for stability and surface protection. A perfect fit for bookshelves, office desks, or as a decorative feature in the living room, these bookends are both functional and visually captivating. Purple hues with unique geode formations provide an elegant, earthy detail certain to complement a wide range of interior styles. The set is in very good condition with only minor wear from previous handling, ensuring it is ready to add practical charm and natural sophistication to your home
